sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/blackberry-crossing-campground ('The campground has 26 sites'); https://www.fs.usda.gov/sites/nfs/files/r09/whitemountain/image/Blackberry%20Crossing%20campground%20site%20map.jpg (sites 7, 15, 16 and 21-26 are drawn as tent sites, with 'Tent Sites Walk-in Only' at 21-26)

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/blackberry-crossing-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'; 'There are coin operated showers at Jigger Johnson campground six miles west')

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/blackberry-crossing-campground ('Single Site: $30 per night'; 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $6 per vehicle per night'), read 2026-11-23

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/blackberry-crossing-campground ('Senior and Access pass holders receive a 50% discount')

note: On the Kancamagus Highway (Route 112) six miles west of Conway, a short walk from the Albany Covered Bridge, the Boulder Loop Trail and the Nanamocomuck ski trail; the Swift River is across the highway. A 1930s CCC camp, with a self-guided tour of the old camp. Coin showers at Jigger Johnson, six miles west. --Claude
summary: FS page confirms first-come only ('Reservations not accepted. All sites first-come, first-served.'; no rec.gov listing), 26 sites, $30 + $6 per extra vehicle, vault toilets, potable water, mid-May to mid-October; no site lengths are published; note rewritten (the unsourced allstays/'rec.gov site A045' length claim dropped).
flags: Rig length unverified: no FS page states site lengths, and there is no recreation.gov listing (the old note's 'rec.gov site A045 35 ft' could not be found, and A045 is not a site number on the FS map; the 'allstays ... up to ~65 ft' claim is secondary). The FS site map draws 17 drive-in sites (1-6, 8-14, 12A, 17, 19, 20) and 9 tent sites (7, 15, 16, 21-26, with 21-26 'Tent Sites Walk-in Only'). Keep (unclear pad size = keep).

Kancamagus/WMNF pass: campers do not need the WMNF recreation pass for the campground itself. FS passes page: 'Other sites, including forest campgrounds and a couple recreation sites are managed by concessionaire and are not covered by the recreation pass. These areas may require additional fees.' The pass is needed to park at listed fee sites, including the nearby 'Boulder Loop Trailhead', 'Lower Falls Day Use Area' and 'Sabbaday Falls Day Use Area'.
Waterfront not waterfront confirmed: the FS site map puts the Swift River on the far side of the Kancamagus Highway from every site.
Phone 603-536-6100 (WMNF Supervisor's Office, from the FS page) kept. Website unchanged.
